notes: Exercises the %kvlookup() retrieval pattern from sashash/06_macros/kvlookup.sas. The declare hash + duplicate:'E' + definekey/definedata/find sequence and the call missing(of &var) miss-branch are inlined verbatim from the macro body. A 5-row demographics master (name, age, height_cm) feeds a 5-row visit stream; four matches return age + height, the unknown name 'Frank' triggers the miss-branch with the macro's WARNING text.
